Retained verbatim using git show, without executing any application or test.
The focused browser harness replaces only the sole inline style in the same
current built RTS HTML. It asserts that masking that style leaves identical
markup/scripts and compares the same public-command checkpoint, selected u0,
390x844 viewport, initial scroll0, and glyph-visibility measurement function.
This is an old-presentation control; it does not substitute old game mechanics.
Runtime and rendered artifact review are restricted to Spark.
